approved_decision.rule: Retain DAYI as a PARTIAL CANDIDATE with lexical semantic core want / desire / intention. Do not approve DAYI as a productive modal auxiliary or modal predicate with governed complement structure. DAYI argument structure and sentence-level syntax remain unresolved pending later grammar gates.
approved_decision.rationale: LEX-016 already carries a PARTIAL want/intention mapping, but no recovered phrase contains DAYI and no modal/complement syntax is attested. Retaining lexical semantics while deferring syntax preserves evidence without inventing grammar.

governance_decisions.decision: Keep DAYI authority CANDIDATE and certainty PARTIAL; do not promote lexical authority under B13.
Do not create DAYI modal-auxiliary status, bare-complement syntax, infinitival syntax or complement markers under B13.
Do not create tense, future, planning or intention-clause grammar from the English/Portuguese glosses.
Preserve B1-B4 phonology: DAYI broad form /da.y.i/ is usable for analysis, but lexical stress remains unresolved and B13 does not change pronunciation.
B13 changes no AN/EN person system, general clause order, interrogative grammar, productivity, lexical authority of other forms, or curriculum slots.
